proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend (net_ib): connection handshake/state-machine rewrite, QP RTR/RTS setup, ECE negotiation, FLID/GID routing, and traffic-class behavior, plus send/recv readiness semantics. Add gin because GIN-specific connect/accept/listen-close paths were changed to use the new IB accept/cancel flow and error cleanup. Add memory because IB MR registration moved to a per-device refcounted MR cache with new ownership/release behavior in reg/dereg paths.
